integrity: Proof uses the exact square-divisor Möbius convolution, fixed-progression Möbius cancellation and fourth-power-free CRT counts; independent finite consistency calculations corroborate but do not prove the infinite limits.
scientific_limitations: For fixed q only; signed discrepancy o_q(x) without explicit rate. No claim of new PNT-AP or effective sign bound.
title: Exact three-way residue-class densities for the square-splitting Möbius function
